MAPPING.NAME: m_CUSTOMERS_STG_TO_DIM_CUSTOMER_SCD2
MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: Maintains DW.DIM_CUSTOMER as SCD Type 2 from the daily CRM snapshot in RAW.CUSTOMERS_STG.

TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_DIM_CUSTOMER_CURRENT
TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Looks up the current version (IS_CURRENT = 'Y') by CUSTOMER_ID and returns CUSTOMER_SK and ROW_HASH.

TRANSFORMATION.NAME: RTR_CHANGE_TYPE
TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Groups: NEW when no current row exists; CHANGED when ROW_HASH differs from NEW_ROW_HASH; UNCHANGED otherwise (dropped). Only CUSTOMER_SEGMENT, LOYALTY_TIER and REGION are Type 2 tracked. SIGNUP_DATE is Type 1 and is overwritten on every version.

TRANSFORMATION.NAME: UPD_EXPIRE_OLD
TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: For CHANGED rows: DD_UPDATE the old version setting EFFECTIVE_TO = SNAPSHOT_DATE - 1 and IS_CURRENT = 'N'.

TRANSFORMATION.NAME: UPD_INSERT_NEW
TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: For NEW and CHANGED rows: DD_INSERT a new version with EFFECTIVE_FROM = SNAPSHOT_DATE, EFFECTIVE_TO = 9999-12-31 and IS_CURRENT = 'Y'.

SESSION.NAME: s_m_CUSTOMERS_STG_TO_DIM_CUSTOMER_SCD2
SESSION.ON_FAILURE: Fails the workflow before the orders session runs, so orders never look up a half-updated dimension.
